name: The Long Winter
effect: All Hunger decay is doubled (lose 2 instead of 1 at Tick). Food gathering yields -1.
ongoing: Persistent all game. Houses give +1 Sanity at sleep (everyone huddles).
art_notes: Frost on windowpanes and bare trees

name: The Scorching Summer
effect: All players start with -2 max Hunger. Energy Drinks restore +1 extra Sanity.
ongoing: Persistent all game. Battery items last 1 extra use. Sport courts yield +1 resource.
art_notes: Cracked earth and a blazing sun through smog

name: The Rotting Autumn
effect: All Food in resource bags spoils 1 per day (remove 1 Food from each location at Dawn). Recipes yield +1 Hunger.
ongoing: Persistent all game. Cloth is easier to find: Gather at any house yields +1 Cloth chance.
art_notes: Falling leaves piling against boarded doors

name: The False Spring
effect: Day 1-3: no Charlie attacks. Day 4+: Charlie attacks everywhere every night.
ongoing: Persistent all game. Sanity regen from sleep is +1 at houses during Days 1-3.
art_notes: Cherry blossoms falling on cracked pavement

name: Total Blackout
effect: All Battery items are removed from the game at setup. Flashlights cannot be crafted.
ongoing: Persistent all game. Fire is the only light source. Charlie is relentless.
art_notes: A pitch-black street with one distant candle

name: Strict Rationing
effect: Market only restocks 1 card every 2 days instead of refilling empty slots each Dawn.
ongoing: Persistent all game. Recipes cost 1 fewer ingredient (min 1). Hunger decay -1 at Tick if you ate cooked food today.
art_notes: A padlocked pantry with a checklist

name: The Full Moon
effect: Charlie never attacks. All Soft threats become Hard threats (gain 2 HP and 1 attack).
ongoing: Persistent all game. Threat deck is shuffled and the bottom 5 cards are removed at setup.
art_notes: A massive yellow moon with silhouettes moving across it

name: The Shortcut
effect: Add a path connection between JamesHouse and BadmintonCourt. Movement between them costs 0 Hunger.
ongoing: Persistent all game. However: that shortcut draws +1 Threat at night at both connected locations.
art_notes: A hole cut in a chain-link fence between yards
